player_prompt.intro: Kai ne Mai kunnawa {player_id}. Kuna wasa da wasan 15-Puzzle. Manufar wasan shine a tsara tiles masu lamba a cikin tsari mai tasowa daga 1 zuwa 15, tare da sararin samaniya a cikin kusurwar dama ta dama. Don yin motsawa, zaka iya zamewa a cikin sararin samaniya (wanda aka wakilta ta hanyar sau biyu, misali __) ta amfani da ɗaya daga cikin umarnin da ke gaba: - 'up': Matsar da tile a ƙasa da sararin samaniya sama. - 'down': Matsar da tile a sama da sararin samaniya ƙasa. - 'left': Matsar da tile zuwa dama na sararin samaniya hagu. - 'right': Matsar da tile zuwa hagu na sararin samaniya dama. Don ƙaddamar da motsi, rubuta shugabanci (misali, 'up', 'down', 'left', ko 'right') a cikin ƙuƙwalwa masu ƙira, misali [up]. An nuna tsarin hukumar na yanzu a ƙasa. Yi amfani da bayanin don warware wuyar warwarewa.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Tsarin motsawa mara inganci. Mai kunnawa {player_id} bai amsa da ingantaccen shugabanci a cikin masu kusurwa ba.
invalid_move.illegal_move: Ƙaƙwalwar ba ta da inganci. Ba za a iya motsa tayal ɗin a cikin hanyar da aka ƙayyade ba.

outcome.win: Barka dai! Mai kunnawa {player_id} ya sami nasarar warware matsalar 15-Puzzle.
outcome.turn_limit: An kai iyakar juyawa. Model ya kammala {percent} kashi na wuyar warwarewa
